newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM raises Nov, Dec rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM raises Nov, Dec rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday it would raise the margin requirement on its November rubber futures contract by 20,000 yen per trading lot and that on the December futures by 10,000 yen.

The increases, aimed at cooling overheated trade, are effective from Wednesday. They will bring the total margin requirement on the November contract to 147,750 yen and that on the December futures to 62,500.
The requirement on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
